59328780.s: Al-Waba Crater (locally known as Maqla Tamiyah) is a deep circular pit in the ground with a diameter of 3 kilometres and a depth of 380 metres, the largest of its kind in the Middle East. It lies 254 km from the city of Taif. The middle of the crater is covered by a white layer of salt, believed to form because rainwater collects at the bottom of the crater, creating a small shallow lake that does not seep into the ground.
